entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 498(A) and read with Section 34 of the IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the 1st accused, being the husband of the defacto complainant and other accused persons are being her relatives, subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally,
and thereby they are alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.

3. According to the learned Counsel for the petitioners, even if the entire allegations levelled against the petitioners as such is believed, the same will not constitute the offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC.
Therefore, the petitioners prayed for quashing all further proceedings against them.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
The petition was strongly opposed by the learned Counsel for the 3rd respondent/defacto complainant as well as the learned Public Prosecutor.
6. On a perusal of the FI statement, it can be seen that several allegations are raised against the accused persons in general.
However, no serious allegations are raised against them with material particulars like date.

In the absence of any specific allegations with material particulars, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioners, as the same will only be an abuse of process of the court.
In the result, this petition is allowed.

The proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos. 1, 2 and 4 in CC. No.420/2024 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Angamali, arising out of Crime No.1206/2024 of Angamali Police Station, Ernakulam, are hereby quashed.
